project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-09. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town
touristAppeal.summary: Useful as a mapped local settlement, but not currently recommended as a tourist destination.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Thriplow
townGuide.intro: Thriplow has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records only defensible visitor interest without presenting the place as a destination.

suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Use the planner to find the strongest in-boundary daytime stops.

townGuide.suggestedTime: As part of a wider local journey
townGuide.visitorMood: A local settlement rather than a tourist destination.
